description.value: Tomm's Food Village is a family-owned, independent grocery store that has served the Bowser and Lighthouse Country community on Vancouver Island for nearly 25 years. It offers a full-service shopping experience including fresh meat, an in-store bakery, deli, produce, bulk foods, and dairy, along with an impressive curated selection of locally sourced Vancouver Island and Gulf Islands products. Cyclists travelling the Island Highway between Qualicum Beach and Fanny Bay will find a genuine community grocer with local specialty items not found in chain stores.

address.value: 6990 West Island Highway, Bowser, BC V0R 1G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: same phone number, same address (minor word-order difference), and an active copyright year of 2026. The website explicitly lists a full line of groceries, fresh meat, in-store bakery, deli meats, produce, bulk foods, and dairy, confirming basic groceries. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water access, or cycling infrastructure are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Minor address word-order discrepancy: OSM records '6990 West Island Highway' while the website uses '6990 Island Highway West' — same road and location, no material concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, full-service independent grocery store on the Island Highway touring corridor between Qualicum Beach and Fanny Bay, with strong local product selection — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address found on website (not in OSM): tommsfoodvillage@shaw.ca. The store is closed Sundays per website, relevant if updating OSM opening_hours tags.
